amends.note: plan v2 is carried forward by reference and hash; this file adds execution constraints and closes open decisions. It does not replace v2 and does not alter its history.

status: pre-specified; no model output exists for any task in the frozen manifest
statistical_content_note: no estimand, weight, population, contrast, bootstrap parameter, or measurement basis is altered by this amendment; it is entirely about execution

E1_resolution_mistral_template.decision: pass an explicit empty system message

verification.method: rendered the pinned template locally with jinja2, substituting a sentinel date 1999-12-31 for strftime_now so any date leakage would be visible; no weights, no model, no GPU

incidental_findings: add_generation_prompt=True is a no-op for this template (no such branch; [/INST] is the generation cue); kept for uniformity
strftime_now is still called on the template's first line even in the empty-system path, so the function must be available; its value never reaches the output

llama.conditional_on: preflight gate confirming no hidden content
llama.known_risk: Llama-3.1 templates in some versions inject a 'Today Date:' string

qwen.basis: emits a system block only when `tools` is passed, which this protocol never does

gemma.conditional_on: preflight gate confirming no hidden content

E2_resolution_hardware_and_placement.gpu_requirement: a single A100 80GB or faster 80GB GPU
E2_resolution_hardware_and_placement.device_map_rationale: 48 GiB peak for the 24B scorer against 80 GiB makes single-device placement viable unchanged; it would have OOM'd on the previous 32 GiB card
residency_gate_checks: if hf_device_map exists, no entry maps to 'cpu', 'disk' or 'meta'
no quantization configuration present on the loaded config
every PARAMETER dtype is torch.bfloat16; non-persistent buffers such as rotary inv_freq may be float32 and are exempt
post-load torch.cuda.memory_allocated() within tolerance of the expected BF16 weight size
E2_resolution_hardware_and_placement.on_failure: abort before any inference and return for review

canonical_task.selection_rule: lexicographically smallest source_task_id in the 500-task primary population; rendering consumes nothing because no inference occurs

record_per_render: first and last input token IDs

fail_conditions.1_residual_content_primary_gate: after removing the frozen user prompt text and the model's control/special tokens, the remainder must contain no alphabetic word of 3+ characters; catches dates, personas and unrequested instructions together, model-agnostically
fail_conditions.2_date_test: no YYYY-MM-DD, DD Mon YYYY or Mon DD, YYYY substring; none of 'current date', 'today', 'todays date', 'knowledge cutoff', 'knowledge base was last updated', 'cutting knowledge date' (case-insensitive)
fail_conditions.3_persona_test: no 'You are <Name>' construction; none of 'Large Language Model', 'created by', 'developed by', 'I am an AI'
fail_conditions.4_instruction_test: subsumed by test 1: evaluation guidance beyond the frozen prompt necessarily leaves residual alphabetic words
fail_conditions.5_reproducibility_test: rendered-text and token-ID hashes frozen at preflight; the run must reproduce them. Self-enforcing against date injection, because a date-bearing template renders differently on a later calendar day

preflight_prompt_render_gate.exception: for mistral only, the empty [SYSTEM_PROMPT][/SYSTEM_PROMPT] tag pair is permitted and is not a residual-content violation
preflight_prompt_render_gate.on_failure: fail the gate and return for review

generation_determinism.applies_to: every scorer and the generator, on every call
generation_determinism.how: after load, set model.generation_config.do_sample=False and temperature/top_p/top_k=None, AND still pass the explicit kwargs; kwarg precedence alone leaves the shipped values resident in the merged config
generation_determinism.rationale: a silent reversion to sampling would be indistinguishable in the output from a real effect

batching.micro_batching_permitted_only_after: demonstrated exact token-for-token equivalence with batch size 1 on the pre-specified smoke set
batching.mistral_batch_determined_only_by: the smoke test; no batch size assumed in advance

equivalence_smoke_set.source: frozen answers from the completed 90-task run
equivalence_smoke_set.contamination: none; these tasks are already used and are not in the study manifest
equivalence_smoke_set.selection_rationale: spans the prompt+answer length range, including two token-capped answers to exercise the longest bucket

batching.equivalence_criterion: sha256 of the GENERATED TOKEN-ID SEQUENCE identical between batch-1 and batched runs for all 144 units
batching.criterion_rationale: text comparison alone can hide a divergence that later changes a parse; padding and attention-mask handling can flip a greedy argmax at a near-tie
batching.on_any_mismatch: that model runs the entire study at batch size 1

checkpoint_and_resume.rationale: the sequential runtime approaches or exceeds a single rental
requirements: every completed call written to JSONL immediately (append + fsync) before the next begins
resume skips any unit already present by unit_id and never regenerates it
a truncated trailing record is repaired on reopen, costing at most the one interrupted unit
resume must be exercised and verified (interrupt and restart) before the long run, not assumed from the code
results synced to durable storage DURING the run, not only at the end
the generator's reserve-substitution path stays disabled; resume must not reintroduce it

revised_runtime_estimate_hours.status: unmeasured on A100; must be measured on a small sample before committing to the full run
revised_runtime_estimate_hours.measurement_vehicle: the 288-call batching smoke test doubles as the throughput measurement

E5_empty_cell_rule.action: average over the non-empty cells in that replicate

E6_independent_verifiers.identities_omitted_here_because: author names in a public repo config during anonymous review would deanonymize the submission; the same reasoning that closes E7 applies to E6's implementation
E6_independent_verifiers.procedure: each verifier performs a blinded pass from response text only, without seeing the other's value
E6_independent_verifiers.on_disagreement: the response remains unresolved and is excluded from every analysis; never split the difference, never prefer a reader

E7_preregistration.action: plan, amendment and all hashes timestamped and retained locally for release after review concludes

unresolved_scientific_decisions.statement: none; the statistical design is settled and carried forward from plan v2 unchanged
remaining_items_are_execution_or_verific: run preflight and pass it, including establishing Llama's and Gemma's template cleanliness which could not be verified off-box
run the batching equivalence smoke test before enabling any micro-batching
measure throughput on a small sample before the full run
exercise resume rather than assume it
implementation change: disable reserve substitution in scripts/generate_scaled_candidates.py
implementation change: add the mistral scorer with its empty-system message to the scorer list
